title: READ: A Retrieval-Alignment Diffusion Framework for Structure-based Drug Design
abstract: arXiv:2506.14488v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) models are central to modern pharmaceutical research, enabling the rational exploration of protein-ligand interactions at atomic resolution. However, most existing approaches frame molecular generation as an isolated optimization or a one-to-one matching task, overlooking the shared binding patterns and intrinsic similarities among protein-ligand complexes. This fragmented perspective constrains their ability to capture the fundamental principles governing molecular recognition and binding specificity. Moreover, the limited availability of high-quality experimental data further hampers model generalization and real-world applicability. To address these challenges, we present READ, a retrieval-alignment molecular generation framework that conditions the generative process on small molecules targeting homologous proteins. translated_title: READ：一种用于基于结构药物设计的检索-对齐扩散框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.14488v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）模型是现代药物研究的核心，能够在原子分辨率下实现蛋白质-配体相互作用的理性探索。然而，大多数现有方法将分子生成视为孤立的优化或一对一匹配任务，忽视了蛋白质-配体复合物之间的共享结合模式和内在相似性。这种碎片化的视角限制了它们捕捉分子识别和结合特异性基本原理的能力。此外，高质量实验数据的有限可用性进一步阻碍了模型的泛化能力和实际应用性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了READ，一种检索-对齐分子生成框架，该框架将生成过程条件化于靶向同源蛋白质的小分子上。检索到的配体通过扩散模型在多种表示形式中对齐。
tldr: 本文提出READ框架，通过检索同源蛋白的配体并用扩散模型对齐，克服了现有SBDD方法忽视共享结合模式和数据稀缺的局限，显著提升了分子生成的相关性和泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the READ framework, which retrieves ligands for homologous proteins and aligns them with a diffusion model, overcoming the limitations of existing SBDD methods that overlook shared binding patterns and data scarcity, thereby enhancing molecular generation relevance and generalization.
